title: Reject conflicting payment webhook retries
problem: The ledger treats every repeated event ID as a harmless retry. If the same ID arrives with a different amount, the conflicting payload is silently accepted and hidden.
acceptance_criteria: An identical event ID and amount remains idempotent.
An identical event ID with a different amount raises ValueError.
A rejected conflicting retry does not change the original ledger entry.
